nonblocking_findings: ADV-P2-R2-1 | severity: low | nonblocking | dashboard/scripts/print/make-pdfx.ts:42-43 | make-pdfx reads the ICC profile from $HOME/.cache/workbooks-print and downloads it from Adobe when it is missing. A print build under a changed HOME therefore needs the network. A first full run failed once for this reason (the new default case, make-pdfx exit 1). The test file now copies the cached profile into the temporary HOME (seedPrintProfile), so no test depends on the network. No production change is needed for the shipped flow.

ADV-P2-R2-2 | severity: low | nonblocking | dashboard/scripts/storytime/make-storytime-book-cover.ts:191-193 | Confirms C3-P2-01 by code reading: '--out' with no value gives path.resolve('') = the working directory, and the guard passes it. No test added: no spec or plan rule requires option-value validation, and a test would write into the working directory. Fix route: Green, in a later chore.
